title: Separating personal from population gains when calibrating EEG foundation models for new users: code and saved results
description: Analysis code, fixed configurations, saved subject-level results, reporting scripts and Supplementary Data 1 for the EEG personalization study. Raw EEG and pretrained weights are obtained separately. See the README for reproduction scope and third-party terms.
